confidence_notes: Reported July 2026 city prices support the meal, cappuccino, and beer anchors. Cocktail and wine estimates use observed local menu prices relative to beer. Lodging is a holistic estimate and is especially uncertain because July is Bariloche's winter ski season.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city used; the lodging estimate reflects Bariloche's Patagonia lake and ski tourism demand.
